jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We are Kingmakers, a customer-centric tech startup, dedicated to creating innovative products that entertain our customers and keep them engaged both online and through our agency operations.

Since the successful launch of our first product, BetKing, in 2018, we have continued our momentum and will soon be introducing our newest offering, SuperSportBet, in South Africa. In partnership with the Multichoice Group and SuperSport, SuperSportBet enhances the passion that sports fans have for the game with a world-class sports betting and casino experience.

As our Kingdom expands, we proudly stand as the leading Sports and Digital Entertainment platform in Africa, and we are still actively hiring an exceptional team of Creators and Innovators across Africa, the United Kingdom, Europe, and the Middle East.

There has never been a better time to join our Kingdom than today!

What we would like you to do:

Have you ever thought of joining a company where your contribution to its product will... help redefine its position within its industry. We are one of the fastest growing companies in our sector, using innovative technology and solving the hardest problems to bring African sports fans unrivalled digital sports and gaming entertainment experiences, online, offline, 24/7.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be joining a team focused on ensuring that our gaming products are highly resilient, extremely low latency and scalable to massive volume, all while providing a first-class customer experience. You and your team will work hand-in-glove with the Product Managers to design, build, deliver and run our gaming platforms and products.

Part of our rapidly growing Tech team, you will have the opportunity to play a crucial role in taking the KingMakers products to the next level!

What you need for this role:
• In-depth knowledge of C# (.Net 7 preferably).
• In-depth knowledge of SQL (Azure Managed).
• Experience writing your own automated tests (Unit Tests or Integration).
• Experience working with containerization technologies (AKS/Kubernetes preferred).
• Practical experience working with messaging technologies (preferably Kafka)
• Good understanding of design patterns.
• Good understanding of architectural best practice (CI/CD, APM, SRE).
• Experience mentoring other engineers.
• A passion for detail and problem solving, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

It would be great if you had experience with:
• Cloud-based technologies (preferably Azure).
• Working with NoSQL Technologies (Preferably MongoDB, ElasticSearch or CosmosDB).
• Infrastructure as code (Terraform).

How you do it – Expectations for fulfilling your role:

As a general rule, at KingMakers, we want people to be:
• Customer Focus: We keep the customer at the center of everything we do.
• Passion & Dedication: We are passionate about what we do, employing only smart, honest, dedicated, and results oriented team players.
• Openness, Honesty & Directness: We embrace a culture of candor and work together towards the right solution whilst being open, honest, and willing to give and receive feedback, judgment-free. We play the ball, not the person.
• Innovation & Big Thinking: We think like owners. If we see a problem, we find a solution. We are pragmatic and always strive to do more with less.
• Speed & Focus: We plan, we strategize, but mostly, we DO. Without doing there is no progress, we can always change direction but only if we start moving. Fast beats slow.
• Low Ego: The best solutions are achieved when we leave our egos at the door. We always seek opportunities to learn in every situation. No job is too small.
• Fun: On balance, we believe in having fun whilst working. We maintain perspective as best as we can, and together, we celebrate our successes.

Beyond our great company benefits and competitive salaries, we recognize that to grow sustainably and thrive positively we need to engage the right talent because our people are a merit to our success. We have an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive and where everybody has a seat at the table.

So, what are you waiting for? Click apply and join our Kingdom today

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Overview

About D+A in PepsiCo

PepsiCo is using the power of data to transform the way our brands are sold every day. Our Data & Analytics group influences every aspect of how we sell and move our products. In just a short period of time, they’ve built new capabilities that have defined the data science roadmap across all of our brands. Members of our team solve complex problems facing our rapidly changing business and get to see their work come to life in the real world.

The Software Engineer will play a pivotal role in software development activities and long-term initiative planning and collaboration across the Strategy & Transformation (S&T) organization. Software Engineering is the corner stone of scalable digital transformation across PepsiCo’s value chain. This candidate will support the end-to-end software development experience, and deliver high quality software as part of the DevOps process.

This candidate will work closely with the user experience, product, IT, and... process engineering teams to develop new products and prioritize deliver solutions across S&T core priorities.

Responsibilities
• Help decision makers by summarizing explored technical topics
• Understanding and describing user requirements
• Understanding how we are creating value for the organization and the people in it.
• Assisting as scrum master according to experience.
• Interact with key business partners to recommend solutions that best meet the strategic needs of the business
• Partner with User Experience, Product Management, IT, Data & Analytics, Emerging Tech, Innovation, and Process Engineering teams to deliver the Digital Products portfolio

Qualifications

What you will need to suceed:

Key Skills/Experience Required
• Technical background, bachelor or master, Computer Science or related field
• Commanding knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and object oriented design
• Minimum 5 years of experience with software development.
• Working knowledge of programming languages such as React, Java, GraphQL , Javascript, SQL or other similar technology
• Experience with a major cloud provider and PaaS / SaaS solutions
• Experience with Software / system architecture or modeling experience
• Experience with Scrum and Azure devops (or similar technology) and interest in driving scrum meetings according to experience level
• Background in databases, datastructures and algorithms

Qualities:
• Attention to quality assurance and correctness while driving delivery
• Strong attention to detail and extremely well-organized
• Ability to manage multiple projects with competing priorities
• Ability to be able to interface with the business and recognize their needs and priorities
• Ability to work cross functionally with product, service design and operations across the organization
• Demonstrated passion for excellence with respect to Engineering services, education, and support
• Ability to work collaboratively with regional and global partners in other functional units

About PepsiCo

We believe that culture should be at the cornerstone of everything we do at PepsiCo. We are agile, innovative and not afraid of failure. We want our team to come to work every day excited to explore new ways to bring enjoyment, refreshment and fun to the world.

PepsiCo Positive (pep+) is the future of our organization – a strategic end-to-end transformation, with sustainability at the center of how we will create growth and value by operating within planetary boundaries and inspiring positive change for the planet and people.

So, if you’re ready to be a part of a playground for those who think big, we’d love to chat.
• We encourage the diversity of applicants across gender, age, ethnicity, nationality, sexual orientation, social background, religion or belief and disability

#Location: Barcelona, Spain

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer Microservices
jobs_results.description:
GMV is an international leader in the area of #satellite control centers.

We are resizing our software teams and are looking for a profile with extensive experience in #microservices and #cloud architectures, with a background in #Java and #C++ for ambitious #space-sector projects.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

You will join a large software development team, which is betting on a technological transformation towards #microservices.

In an international environment with projects for the main international telecommunications satellite operators. It is required an intermediate level of English both written and spoken.

You will participate in the design of product updates, SW development, research of new solutions and evolution of our products, operational support to our clients...

The projects are stable and long term.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

Experts and... passionate about software development and service-oriented architecture, looking for challenges and bring new knowledge and experience to complement the team.

You will join a consolidated software team with great domain of the industry and product with #SCRUM methodology.

Technologies:

#Java #C++, Load Balancing, #APIs (REST, WebSockets OpenAPI), Containers (#Docker, #Kubernetes), #API Gateways, #SpringBoot, Mysql, Architectures (#Redis), Ansible, GIT, #Jenkins/Bamboo.

React, #Python are valued.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Laura Uribarren, in charge of this vacancy.

Laura Uribarren

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer - Observability - Receivers (Remote, Spain)
jobs_results.description:
What is Grafana Cloud?

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack

The Observability department is focused on enabling developers to understand the health and performance of their applications in any environment by providing tools to instrument their code, ingest observability data into Grafana Cloud and visualize and explore it.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. We are looking for Engineers that are passionate about communicating with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Engineers at Grafana also... have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities.

What will you be doing?

Responsibilities

We are the team that is responsible for Ingestion Paths, Pipelines, and services for Observability. We route, process, and transform data that is being ingested into our backend databases, to give the data value to the end user. Some of the projects were involved with include:
• App Olly - Tempo Metrics Generation
• Kubernetes/App Olly Integration
• Agent Management
• FE Olly – Faro Collector/API
• Work with your team to deliver new functionality, then use the results to iterate and improve
• Contributing to and reviewing design documents for upcoming features
• Embrace our open-source culture and contribute to other projects that may not directly fall within your team’s scope
• Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your career objectives
• Be a part of your team’s on-call rotations and take ownership of the services you’re running
• Mentor and support other team members, participate in design discussions, and collaborate with the team
• Regularly sharing ideas and knowledge across a vast array of technical ideologies and mindsets
• Working closely with the other squads in the Observability

As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so an independent attitude and good communication skills are a must.

What are we looking for in you?
• You are comfortable working in a remote-first company; communication is key. For us, working together means being collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful. We operate by consensus, you can contribute to a discussion but then commit to the team decision.
• You are eager to learn and grow. Our team is currently looking to double in size over the next year. There is a lot of room for growth and development, and the team has quite a lot of knowledge to share for those who are willing to learn.
• You enjoy working on complex solutions – Grafana is a highly technological solution and has avid followers who rely on it every day and care deeply about their workflows.
• You enjoy being part of the community. Community is part of our core, and interacting with the community is a day-to-day thing for us. At the same time, you know how to recognize ideas and solutions that bring the biggest value to them and have the biggest impact on their experience.
• You approach development holistically. The team owns the full life cycle of our code; from writing design docs, to looking at community feedback, and integration testing. We appreciate engineers who enjoy looking at the big picture, and also notice the details of the brush strokes.
• You have some experience with operating your code, and the intricacies thereof. Since a lot of operators and developers use our software, having some grounding in both of these spaces really helps us with building better software for our users.

Requirements
• Have solid experience with Go
• Good understanding of storage solutions with an emphasis on relational databases like MySQL, SQLite, and Postgres
• Care deeply about developer and user experience and the quality of the products that you work on
• Have some experience with delivering projects from gathering requirements, and brainstorming ideas to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven way
• Have experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others
• Have experience with mentoring junior engineers in a collaborative but asynchronous environment
• Enjoy working on complex solutions – Grafana is a highly technical solution and has avid followers who rely on it every day and care deeply about their workflows.
• Can take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve tight learning loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback, and then progress iteratively
• Familiarity with being on-call and performing operations/SRE tasks

Bonus Points
• Experience with open-source software and/or commercial open-source companies
• Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes
• Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, or Developer Efficiency work streams
• Been a user of Grafana and Prometheus in operational roles
• Exposure to microservices architecture and distributed systems, or a desire to learn

In the Spain, the base compensation range for this role is €88,627 - €106,353. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.
• Compensation ranges are country-specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process

About Grafana Labs: There are more than 20M users of Grafana, the open source visualization tool, around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps. The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a NASA launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France. Grafana Labs also helps more than 3,000 companies -- including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay -- manage their observability strategies with the Grafana LGTM Stack, which can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud or self-managed with the Grafana Enterprise Stack, both featuring scalable metrics (Grafana Mimir), logs (Grafana Loki), and traces (Grafana Tempo).

Benefits: For more information about the perks and benefits of working at Grafana, please check out our careers page.

Equal Opportunity Employer: At Grafana Labs we’re building a company where a diverse mix of talented people want to come, stay, and do their best work. We know that our company runs on the hard work and the dedication of our passionate and creative employees. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways.

We will recruit, train, compensate and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, disability, age, veteran status, and all the other fascinating characteristics that make us different and unique. We believe that equality and diversity builds a strong organization and we’re working hard to make sure that’s the foundation of our organization as we grow.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy

jobs_results.title: Senior FullStack Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
We’re on the search for a highly experienced Senior Fullstack Software Engineer, ready to join our Development team in building and supporting our Plytix PIM. Our Development team is based in Malaga, but if you code best from the comfort of your own home or even from a different city, no problem—the location doesn’t matter, you do!

What is Plytix?

This is where you’d typically see a long paragraph of boring text that no one reads, peppered with corporate buzzwords that don’t mean anything. But Plytix is no typical company, so we’ll spare you from that. Instead, watch this video, and if you like what you see, keep scrolling.

👉 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nGQDV5fNGp4

What’s the opportunity?

This is your chance to play a part in building a leading multichannel platform, working with diverse talent and innovative technology. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of an ever-expanding scale-up with your ideas and coding experience.

What will you be doing?

A day... in the life of a Plytix developer is an exciting one. You’ll be collaborating on challenges, like taking an active role in the service designs and making sure that they are scalable and robust. You will need to ensure these designs are implemented following the latest design patterns and best practices. You’ll have scrum ceremonies to stay on the same page as your fellow developers, from retrospective meetings to sprint planning. You’ll always be aligned with your team for when you dive into pull requests or user stories. All in all, you’ll be a busy bee. But don’t worry, there’s always time to crack open a beer and have fun!

After 1 month:

You’ll have a good grasp of our favorite tools and processes, and your code will start flowing. You’ll start reviewing user stories and will be given small tasks so that you can start to show off your engineering skills. You’ll take part in peer reviews with QA, making sure that clients don’t spot any errors before we do.

After 3 months:

You’re now becoming a true Plytix dev, evaluating and estimating user stories. You’re writing tests and working more independently. You still have some supervision, but at this point, you’re feeling comfortable with what you are doing. You’re taking part in sprints and beginning to integrate well into the team’s workflow.

6 months in:

You’re fully integrated into the team. You work just as well (and as quickly) as anyone else on the team! You’re collaborating with other departments to find the best possible solutions for our customers to have the best quality system. You’re delivering high-quality, fast-running code that’ll be tested to iron out any potential errors. By now, you’re confident in your role, reviewing and approving other engineers’ code (always following our standards, of course!) and even providing advice to junior developers.

Who will you be working with?

You’ll be working with your fellow frontend and backend engineers, making sure that everything is running smoothly, but they aren’t the only shining faces you’ll be working with on a daily basis. You’ll also be working with the QA and Product teams to keep customers smiling about how amazing their Plytix PIM is.

If you’re curious about what our dev culture is like, take a peek at what Plytix’s development team has to offer —you know you want to.

We expect you to:
• At least 8 years of work experience in web software development
• Have 5+ years of experience in Frontend technologies
• Proven experience in Angular2+ Frontend Development (3+ years)
• Proven experience in Python Backend Web Development (3+ years)
• Strong Python 3+ foundations (Parallelism/Concurrency/generators/decorators/etc.)
• High level of knowledge of RxJs and how it works under the hood
• Strong vanilla JavaScript foundations
• Experience working in an environment based on Docker, Kubernetes and Linux as O.S.

You might also have:
• Experience in message brokers like RabbitMQ
• Understanding of cloud-native distributed systems and microservices

Nice to have:
• Experience with Web ComponentsExperience working with CI/CD tools
• Knowledge of Micro Frontends with Angular (SingleSPA or similar)

Why work at Plytix?

🏆 Voted Malaga’s #1 employer by Great Place to Work®

❤️ Be a part of a welcoming culture with bright, friendly people from around the world

🌱 Have a purpose and plenty of opportunities to grow from day one

🖥 Work from home or from our offices in the center of Malaga

💰 55k - 75k will be determined based on experience and expertise

🏡 Flexible working hours and unlimited remote days

🍲 Catered, free lunches and unlimited ice cream when working from the office

🏋 More perks like biweekly events

🎂 Don’t work on your birthday—enjoy an extra day of paid time off

📅 Holidays: 23 work days + 24th & 31st December off

About our culture:

If you love reading ‘empowering’ phrases like “vibrant collective” and “innovative individuals,” then be prepared to be disappointed…

That’s because to get a typical result, you have to do only typical things. But that’s not really our style.

We’re a community of chill and fun-loving humans who believe that work doesn’t have to be boring. We make each day exciting by collaborating together and enjoying the occasional bout of silliness: like a pool competition, potluck, party, or game of padel.

We’re kind of the cool kids in the PIM playground (if we do say so ourselves), and we love to challenge the status quo to help anyone break free from f*#king boring spreadsheets

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Developer .NET
jobs_results.description:
Hola

¿Te apasiona la innovación tecnológica?

Te contamos… Airplane Solutions es una compañía que desarrolla proyectos y productos de innovación, modernización tecnológica y arquitectura disruptiva, en entorno Microsoft para brindar las mejores soluciones de software personalizadas, flexibles y potentes para el sector aeronáutico ✈️

¿QUÉ BUSCAMOS? 🔎

Un perfil Senior Developer con más de 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones backend con .NET que se sienta cómodo y disfrute trabajando en:
• Entorno cloud Azure
• Diseño de arquitecturas basadas en microservicios
• Un modelo de trabajo basado en la cultura DevOps y en la revisión por pares

¿QUÉ HARÁS? ✍️
• Procesos de CI/CD como parte del ciclo de vida del software con Azure DevOps
• AzureDurable Functions
• AzureContainer Apps
• Azure Storage Services
• Azure API Management
• Azure Data explorer y Cosmos DB
• Azure Application Insights como herramienta de monitorización y detección de errores.
• Desarrollo de software... orientado a eventos con Azure Eventgrid
• Aplicación de patrones de diseño
• Despliegue de infraestructura con el uso de Pulumi y ARM
• Aplicaciones web basadas en Blazor

Además, valoramos 🧐

Que tengas un nivel de inglés fluido hablado y escrito

Interés personal por todo lo relacionado con la tecnología y el desarrollo de software en general.

Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo

¿QUÉ TE OFRECEMOS? 🙌

📄 Contrato indefinido

💰 Salario acorde al mercado y a la experiencia y conocimientos que aportarás

🏠 Modalidad de Trabajo híbrida, nos adaptamos a tus necesidades y a las del proyecto, no estamos en la oficina por estar

📍 Ubicación Oficinas en Esplugues de Llobregat

📚 Formación técnica y de soft-skills para reforzar esas áreas que tu consideras necesarias para alcanzar tu máximo potencial

🎓 Certificaciones oficiales de Microsoft. Valoramos tu esfuerzo y lo incentivamos con un premio por obtenerlas

👨👩👧 Libertad y flexibilidad horaria. Somos flexibles con tu tiempo, solo tienes que asegurarte de que esté bien con tu equipo

⏰ Viernes y agosto jornada intensiva de 8 a 3

🤝Excelente ambiente de trabajo que se basa en la confianza y la corresponsabilidad de todo el equipo

🏖️ 23 días de vacaciones retribuidas + 2 días extra para aprovechar los puentes

🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre, para que lo celebres como prefieras

🎖️ Team Building en primavera y otoño en donde nos relajamos, disfrutamos y exploramos actividades de muchos estilos

🎉 Evento corporativo en Navidad para disfrutar juntos de buenos momentos

👩⚕️ Seguro médico privado a cargo de la empresa

🍽 Tarjeta Restaurante a cargo de la empresa también

Si has llegado hasta aquí, seguro que te apetece conocernos un poco más…

¿Cómo somos en Airplane?

Profesionales, Cercanos, Curiosos, Talentosos, Diversos, por eso buscamos atraer al mejor talento para que se una a nuestro equipo.

… y un dato importante!

Las investigaciones han demostrado que las mujeres son menos propensas que los hombres a postularse para un puesto si no tienen una experiencia sólida en el 100% de lo que se busca en las ofertas de empleo. En Airplane creemos que la diversidad de género en el equipo, al incluir diferentes perspectivas y experiencias, nos permite innovar y encontrar soluciones más creativas y eficientes, Así que, incluso si crees que solo tienes un 75% de coincidencia, no dudes en participar en el proceso, porque estamos seguros de que las habilidades se pueden aprender, la diversidad no👩🏻💻👩🏽💻

No pierdas la oportunidad... ¡Contáctanos

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

Hi, we’re Nexthink. We’re not just the leader in Digital Employee Experience, we invented the market. Our solutions combine real-time analytics, automation and employee feedback across all endpoints to help IT teams delight people at work. Our cloud-native platform pinpoints issues and solutions, automates response, and helps companies continuously improve their employees’ experience, making them more productive, efficient, and happy at work. We have millions of endpoints deployed, we’ve surpassed $100M in ARR, and we’ve recently secured $180M in Series D financing for a company valuation of $1.1B, but we’re just getting started. 

Headquartered in Switzerland, Nexthink also has offices in France, the UK, Germany, Spain, UAE, India, Saudi Arabia, Australia, and the US. Our growing team of Nexthinkers is proud to be making the digital work lives of seven million employees across 1,000 customers more productive.

This is an exceptional opportunity to join a... fast-growing, successful, and innovative company. Nexthink allows you to thrive in a unique work environment that emphasizes excellence, innovation, openness, and collaboration.

Job Description

We are looking for a strong JavaScript/TypeScript engineer with a great level of expertise in the JavaScript ecosystem. This is a full-stack position where you’ll be working on Front-end React applications, backend Node.js micro-services and cloud services with AWS.

You’ll be part of the team in charge of the application shell and micro-frontend architecture for which you will interact closely with the Architecture and DevOps teams.

This is a unique opportunity to join a high-impact team where you’ll be able to grow and learn about modern, enterprise scale, web technologies.

If you are highly motivated and result-driven, you have a high sense of product ownership, constantly learning and enhancing your skills, you are open to feedback and you like being accountable and working within a team, then, do not hesitate to apply.

What you’ll do
• Define and build the next generation micro-frontend architecture
• Enable front-end developers by providing tools and libraries to improve developer experience
• Design and build cloud native web applications
• Maintain the highest code quality standards by using different metrics and by helping the team to improve its best practices in the development
• Put in place the necessary test automation to achieve excellent software quality
• Work with the agile iterative/incremental mindset and best practices and participate actively in the different ceremonials
• Handle L3 support requests (together with the rest of the team)
• Document the solutions and architecture according to our standard

Qualifications
• Strong technical background, with a clear focus on web technologies
• B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science (or equivalent), MSc preferred
• Strong programming skills and ability to code in JavaScript, TypeScript
• Experience with React is a must. Others like Angular, jQuery, Ember will be valued
• Experience with Express.js, GraphQL or similar
• Experience with CDN
• Familiar with Unit, integration and E2E tests (testing library, playwright, Cypress, etc…)
• Experience with module federation is a plus
• Experience with CI/CD is a plus
• Experience with micro-services, Docker and Kubernetes a plus
• Strong motivation for complex challenges and learning new technologies
• Fluent in English (spoken and written)

Additional Information

We are 900+ employees strong in 21 countries across 8 different time zones speaking 60+ languages. We are positive, we get things done, we keep growing, and we are one team, we are Nexthink. We believe actions are stronger than words when it comes to diversity, inclusion, and equity in the workplace. Nexthinkers are multinational and multilingual, and come from all walks of life. We are committed to hiring a genuinely representative workforce that can create solutions and foster innovation for the modern digital employee experience.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a Senior de Hardware
jobs_results.location: Santiago de Compostela, Municipality of Santiago de Compostela, Spain
jobs_results.description:
Desde nuestro Departamento de Programas Estratégicos de Televés estamos buscando un/a Ingeniero/a Senior de HW que pueda participar y gestionar en el desarrollo de nuestro productos IoT, fundamentalmente de gateways o concentradores de datos avanzados que faciliten el procesamiento en el Edge, pero también para ayudar en el diseño de innovadores sensores IoT.

Funciones
• Liderar proyectos electrónicos trabajando en coordinación con otras áreas (Software, firmware, mecánica, industrialización, normativa y aprovisionamiento).
• Diseñar, modificar y mejorar el Hardware de nuestros productos.
• Participar activamente en el diseño del producto, trabajando con el equipo de Ingeniería de Software de manera coordinada y con gran capacidad de innovación.
• Verificar y validar prototipos y preseries.
• Aportar nuevas ideas de mejora, tanto al nivel de producto como de mejoras internas.
• Coordinarse con el resto del equipo técnico para la realización de los trabajos asignados.
• Trabajar bajo... los requisitos de fiabilidad y de calidad de la empresa teniendo en cuenta la situación tecnológica del mercado.
• Elaborar y revisar documentaciones relativas a producto.

Perfil
• Estudios en Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones o Electrónica.
• Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo electrónico / hardware.
• Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en gestión de proyectos de desarrollo.
• Se valorará especialmentela experiencia en el desarrollo de soluciones digitales basadas en procesadores con arquitecturas de más de 32 bits y la integración de interfaces de conectividad inalámbricos con las diferentes fuentes de datos, así como de dotar de conectividad móvil (5G o 6G) a los procesadores
• Conocimientos de: Programas de diseño de circuitos impresos, entradas y salidas analógicas, circuitos electrónicos digitales y tratamiento digital de señal.
• Conocimiento de los diferentes buses y protocolos de comunicaciones MODBUS, ZigBee, BT, ISM, SPI, I2C, …
• Buscamos un perfil versátil y ágil con buena capacidad de gestión y gran autonomía.

Se ofrece
• Incorporación inmediata y estable a una Corporación multinacional gallega que sigue creciendo y fabricando en Galicia.
• Formación continua según tus necesidades.
• Flexibilidad horaria que permite conciliar y gestionar tu tiempo.
• Posibilidad de teletrabajo 2 días a la semana.
• Paquetes de Retribución Flexible, Fisioterapia in house, Catering, y muchos otros beneficios

• Trabajar bajo... los requisitos de fiabilidad y de calidad de la empresa teniendo en cuenta la situación tecnológica del mercado.
• Elaborar y revisar documentaciones relativas a producto.

Perfil
• Estudios en Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones o Electrónica.
• Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo electrónico / hardware.
• Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en gestión de proyectos de desarrollo.
• Se valorará especialmentela experiencia en el desarrollo de soluciones digitales basadas en procesadores con arquitecturas de más de 32 bits y la integración de interfaces de conectividad inalámbricos con las diferentes fuentes de datos, así como de dotar de conectividad móvil (5G o 6G) a los procesadores
• Conocimientos de: Programas de diseño de circuitos impresos, entradas y salidas analógicas, circuitos electrónicos digitales y tratamiento digital de señal.
• Conocimiento de los diferentes buses y protocolos de comunicaciones MODBUS, ZigBee, BT, ISM, SPI, I2C, …
• Buscamos un perfil versátil y ágil con buena capacidad de gestión y gran autonomía.

Se ofrece
• Incorporación inmediata y estable a una Corporación multinacional gallega que sigue creciendo y fabricando en Galicia.
• Formación continua según tus necesidades.
• Flexibilidad horaria que permite conciliar y gestionar tu tiempo.
• Posibilidad de teletrabajo 2 días a la semana.
• Paquetes de Retribución Flexible, Fisioterapia in house, Catering, y muchos otros beneficios

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Developer - Slots Games
jobs_results.description:
WIN SYSTEMS is a provider of casino solutions for the global gaming industry. The Company specializes in management systems and gaming machines for all varieties of casinos and lotteries.

As a Game Developer, you will be responsible for maintaining, expanding, and/or creating all parts of the recreational software, from communication with peripherals, the integration of mathematics, game logic, and painting. We work in the C# platform, DirectX 9. As a gaming developer in our team, you will develop everything from drivers for HW to embedded systems, Ssot SW, and satellite tools.

You will play a pivotal role in the development and execution of our gaming projects. Your expertise in game design, programming, and team leadership will be crucial in driving the success of our games. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to bring innovative ideas to life, ensuring high-quality gameplay experiences for our players.

Responsibilities
• Lead the design and implementation of game... systems, mechanics, and features from concept to release.
• Collaborate with game designers, artists, and other developers to define technical requirements and ensure the successful integration of gameplay elements.
• Mentor and provide guidance to junior developers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices.
• Conduct code reviews and contribute to the establishment and maintenance of coding standards and practices.
• Collaborate with QA teams to identify and address bugs, performance issues, and other technical challenges.
• Communicate effectively with stakeholders to provide project updates, address concerns, and solicit feedback throughout the development process.
• Translate requirements into complicated but clean and efficient code
• Create unit tests and validation procedures to ensure quality

Requirements
• Proven experience (5+ years) in game development, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead role.
• Developer with high knowledge in C# (Preferably also knowledge in C++).
• Experience in the sector of Gaming, Casino Gambling, and/or graphics applications.
• Knowledge in client-server and peripheral communications.
• Knowledge of development tools on Windows (Visual Studio, Team Foundation…)
• Strong understanding of game design principles, gameplay mechanics, and player psychology.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
• Fluent level of English and Spanish.

Why work with us?
• Excellent working environment.
• Restaurant Ticket (1.980€/year).
• English classes.
• Flexible remuneration (Childcare ticket, transportation ticket, etc)
• Beverages and fruits in the office.
• Flexible schedule.
• Padel court and Gym in the offices.
• Games room.

Are you the person we are looking for? Send us your CV, we would love to get to know you

jobs_results.title: Sr. Software Engineer (Generative AI)
jobs_results.description:
¡Nuestro Centro de Excelencia en IA Generativa sigue creciendo!

Buscamos incorporar un perfil de Sr. Software Engineer especializado /a en Inteligencia Artificial que nos ayude a construir soluciones de IA generativa. El campo de aplicación es amplio, ya que damos soporte cross a todas las áreas de la compañía, desde funciones de soporte G&A a Business Lines con soluciones que persiguen maximizar la productividad en el delivery.

¿CUANTAS OFERTAS HAS LEÍDO HOY Y NO TE OFRECEN LO QUE ESTÁS BUSCANDO?¿Quieres trabajar en una empresa líder del sector de la tecnología?

En @INETUM estamos buscando profesionales con pasión.

Si lo que quieres es trabajar en un empleo que te aporte un reto tecnológico, ampliar tus conocimientos e integrarte en un área especializada, este es tu sitio.

Requerimos profesionales con experiencia en AI.

¿QUÉ FORMACIÓN NECESITAS?

Buscamos profesionales con titulación universitaria (preferiblemente en disciplinas técnicas como Ingeniería Superior Informática, de... Telecomunicación Grado o similar).

Todas las certificaciones técnicas son valorables, por favor, no dudes en incluirlas en tu perfil si cuentas con ellas.

Si no posees esta formación, pero si experiencia en el puesto, no te preocupes, valoraremos tus conocimientos.

Descripción del Rol:

Como Ingeniero/a de Software Senior dentro de nuestra Unidad de Negocio de Inteligencia Artificial Generativa, desempeñarás un papel fundamental en el desarrollo de soluciones de vanguardia utilizando tecnologías Python, Java o .Net. Aprovechando tu experiencia en Inteligencia Artificial Generativa, contribuirás al desarrollo de aplicaciones impulsadas por IA que transforman negocios.

Responsabilidades Clave:
• Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener APIs dentro de arquitecturas de microservicios.
• Colaborar con equipos multifuncionales para implementar soluciones de software escalables y eficientes.
• Utilizar tu experiencia con Google Cloud, Azure o AWS para implementar y gestionar aplicaciones en entornos de nube.
• Impulsar la innovación manteniéndote al tanto de los últimos avances en Inteligencia Artificial Generativa e incorporándolos en nuestras soluciones. Requisitos:
• Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación o campo relacionado.
• Mínimo 4 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software.
• Proficiencia en Python, Java o .Net.
• Experiencia en el desarrollo de APIs dentro de arquitecturas de microservicios.
• Familiaridad con plataformas en la nube como Google Cloud, Azure o AWS.

OTRAS HABILIDADES REQUERIDAS:

Clara vocación tecnológica.

Buen discurso y trato con cliente. Se valorará experiencia en comunicación con

clientes finales, defensa de ofertas y reuniones técnicas.

Interés por trabajar en equipo.

Motivación por integrarse en equipos multidisciplinares y de diferentes países.

¿ESTAMOS HABLANDO DE TI? NO TE VAYAS TODAVÍA

¿QUÉ PODEMOS OFRECERTE?

🙋♀️💻 Formarás parte de un gran equipo de profesionales con inquietud y motivación por el desarrollo y la programación.

⏱ Trabajarás a jornada completa con un horario flexible y teletrabajo real.

👩🏼🎓 Formación por parte de la empresa para que puedas seguir desarrollándote y promocionar dentro del plan de carrera que existe para ti.

🎮 Podrás asistir a eventos y conferencias relevantes del sector.

✍🏼 Contrato indefinido.

😄 Estabilidad y buen clima laboral.

💰 Salario Competitivo.

🆓 Acceso a ventajas del grupo de empresa

💵 Retribución flexible y más beneficios
